Recurday

About

Creating family traditions. It was always about the small things.

Not the big holidays. The ones your family makes your own.

Recurday is a free app for the small days a family makes their own. Text a link, add photos of the day you keep, and come back next year to rewatch as the kids grow.

Photos only — it's about staying in the moment. There is no app store, and there are no likes, rankings, or public lists.

The code is open source at github.com/BGarofalo1/recurday. Family photos and private links are not in that repository. They stay with the family who made them.

Need a starting point? See Ideas. For how we keep data, see Privacy and Terms.
